title: synth-vdr distractors
description: The answer-key document listing every planted distractor (an alarming-looking item that resolves to nothing) in a synthetic data room. YAML is canonical; this schema documents the shape for anyone authoring or generating a key by hand.

id.description: Stable identifier for the distractor, e.g. "DX-1".

shape_matches.description: ID of a real finding this distractor is shaped to resemble. Must resolve to a finding id when set.

location.description: Relative path to the document that raises the alarm.

resolution.description: Relative path to the document that resolves the alarm. Must differ from location — the resolving evidence must live in a separate document.
